name: blog
label: Blog
help_text: The HubSpot blog this listing pulls posts from.

name: filter_tags
label: Filter Tags
help_text: Which existing HubSpot blog tags should appear as filter options, and in what order. This only controls the filter UI — it does not create or duplicate any blog content. An "All Posts" option is always shown first automatically.

children.name: tag
children.label: Tag
children.help_text: Pick an existing HubSpot blog tag.

name: featured
label: Featured Blog
help_text: Shown full-width directly below the filters, only when "All Posts" is the active filter. Its image, title, URL, and (for blog posts) tag all come automatically from the selected page below — the only thing you write here is the handwritten note.

children.name: featured_page
children.label: Featured page
children.help_text: Select the page or blog post to feature. Its image, title, and URL are pulled automatically; if the selected item is a blog post, its tag is pulled automatically too — nothing here is re-typed manually. NOTE: this is HubSpot's native page-picker field type, so its content-type coverage (which kinds of pages it lists) is controlled by HubSpot, not by this module; if a blog post you expect doesn't appear in the picker, that's this field type's own scope, not a bug here. If a normal (non-blog) page is selected, no tag is shown — that's expected.

children.name: aside_text
children.label: Handwritten note
children.help_text: Short handwritten-style note shown beside the "Read the guide" button (e.g. the most-asked question you get). This is the only manually-written Featured Blog content — everything else comes from the selected page above.
children.default: “What’s the one question you get asked the most?” This is it.

default.aside_text: “What’s the one question you get asked the most?” This is it.

name: posts_per_page
label: Posts per page
help_text: Number of regular listing cards shown per page (not counting the Featured Blog Post).
